items.title: Henry "Booker T." Glass Interview, 1962-03-22
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Did you know Black Baby? Brickley, they called him Black Baby? No. He had one of those bands around. [INTERVIEWEE] Yeah, they had a Washboard band.

ctx.x: The one who was playing the band, the Washboard. Oh yeah? He'd have that Kodgen. I got one of them little Kodgen home. A little tin Kodgen. That's what he'd play.
If you can play them, all right? They sound real good. Oh yeah. The tin Kodgen. Did you know Black Baby? Brickley, they called him Black Baby? No. He had one of those bands around.
Yeah, they had a Washboard band.
